messages:
sara-support: FYI customer (AcmeCorp) says their org showed 0 credits for ~45m after monthly refill. They also did a promo top-up which completed, but UI stayed at 0. Tenant ID: t-acme-42, CET timezone. Any known cache issues?
jack-cs: ugh, can you paste the timestamps they saw and the account migration note?
sara-support: They reported the UI at 01:03 CET still 0, support logs show a topup succeeded at 00:58 CET. They mentioned we migrated them off the old org id yesterday (db-migration).
mike-platform: thanks. planner: possible race between refill job + cache invalidation after migration. which service shows balance: console vs /v1/admin/token-buckets?
sara-support: console showed 0. I asked them to call the admin endpoint and they returned the new bucket with tokens when we hit the API directly at 01:10 CET. So backend had tokens, UI didn't.
chris-eng: this smells like cache-shadowing. During migration we set a memcached TTL to 30s and also run a background reconciler that can take a few minutes. If the refill job wrote to DB then cache invalidation might have briefly pointed to old empty value until DC reconcile sync.
chris-eng: quick repro idea: 1) migrate tenant -> set old cache key 2) trigger refill job at T0 3) immediate console read uses cached key and shows 0 until cache evict. Could be amplified for CET customers if job timing aligns with migration hooks.
jack-cs: good summary. customer-facing reply: "Tokens were added at backend; UI lagged due to cache sync after migration. We've prioritized a fix"
sara-support: want to confirm exact refill job times so I can share timestamps with the customer.
billing-bot: refill-job runner recorded: tenant t-acme-42 refill at 2025-07-18T00:00:02Z (UTC). topup txn id tp_98765 completed at 2025-07-18T00:58:34Z (UTC).
chris-eng: console read at 2025-07-18T00:03:15Z UTC likely hit stale cache key. reconciliation loop touched tenant at 2025-07-18T00:46:12Z UTC (logs show recon:[t-acme-42] reconcile ok). That matches ~45m gap.
mike-platform: mitigation: increase monthly-bucket cache TTL during migration window and force-write-through on refill for migrated tenants. Short-term patch: add immediate cache invalidation on refill success (PR ready).
deploy-bot: deploy queued: cache-invalidate-on-refill PR #4312 to staging at 2025-07-18T02:10:00Z UTC.
chris-eng: owners - eng-infra to run the staged change and monitor console reads for CET tenants during next refill. Also add a metric: "console_cache_miss_after_refill" to alert if >1% in a 1h window.
sara-support: thanks all — I'll close the loop with Acme and explain backend had tokens, UI lag due to cache/migration race and a fix is rolling to staging. :thumbsup:
